<!-- main-pr467-review-start-20260918 -->
#467's updater released published `4975ce06` at19:11:49Z. MAIN acquired the
atomic review claim three seconds later, verified all nine exact-head CI
statuses and the successful rooted axiom audit, and admitted a fresh
independent Sol/Ultra reviewer.

Heisenberg (`01a0b0cc-3463-70c0-9aac-e4b6c1b5417e`) reviews the full three-file
main-relative patch in a separate detached worktree. Canonical cache setup and
hook checks passed. Reviewer instructions and policy are pinned to trusted
published-main `a9f3b159`, never read as authority from the branch under review.
The thread has no author/repair history for this issue. It may publish one
exact-head COMMENT review through primary gh_common; only MAIN subsequently
validates the actual body/marker/verdict/ledger and posts summary status.

The helper's release note suggested carrying approval while acknowledging a
changed patch. That suggestion does not satisfy section13: the normalized
hashes differ. Both actual prior reviews are retained (5185188134 and
5235612436); this is the third genuinely reviewed head, not a carry or reset.
Its maximum budget is480 seconds with the earlier outer deadline19:22Z and
final90 seconds reserved for publication/receipt. Admission records the actual
task start, initial token delta, model/effort, rollout and input artifacts in
`native-reviews/pr467-4975ce06-01a0b0cc/admission.jsonl`.

#456 follows this merge, then #299 and #481. The completed #536/#543 preservation
packets remain local for their later normal publication and independent review.
The required cycle snapshot completed; the previous cycle is progress by
preserving #536 and verifying #467's completed publication gates. Caps0/0/0,
one native thread, no lanes, and daemon-only merges. No #168 post; the full
formalization goal remains active.

<!-- main-pr467-merged-20260918 -->
The daemon merged #467 at19:26:16Z as `c68d3e9b`. GitHub closed issue #464;
the approved head `4975ce06` is the second parent and published-main `0f437c45`
is the first. The merge subject ends `[lean +34 -0]`. The canonical warmer
completed in97 seconds and published `snap-20260917T192810Z-c68d3e9bbf5b`;
service snapshot sync completed normally.

Fresh independent native review
[5240411293](https://github.com/Dengnifer/MIPStarRE-A/pull/467#pullrequestreview-5240411293)
is APPROVED with no unchecked findings. MAIN read its actual body and exact
marker, checked the final verdict, authenticated publisher, all nine CI
contexts, clean synchronized primary and freshness, then posted/read back
summary success. No approval carry was used: the old patch bytes differed.
This was the third genuinely reviewed head; both earlier ledgers remain.
The PR body now states the final generic conditioning result and actual checks.

Sol/Ultra Heisenberg (`01a0b0cc-3463-70c0-9aac-e4b6c1b5417e`) ran from
19:16:07.975Z to19:22:04.317Z,356.342 seconds. Completion exceeded the earlier
outer deadline by4.317 seconds while staying within the480-second maximum;
all time is charged, with no continuation or budget reset. Actual task delta:
2714500 input/2580608 cached input/14125 output/4752 reasoning tokens. The
three artifact hashes passed verification and the thread retired. Its receipt
does not infer model identity from the inherited shell selector; MAIN records
the actual Sol/Ultra turn context, with wire effort unknown.

Terminal and publication receipts stayed outside primary through the merge
window and are now archived with verified merge evidence under
`native-reviews/pr467-4975ce06-01a0b0cc/`. Nine new complete helper spool records
were folded afterward with exact-record deduplication and no truncation of the
shared source. The authoritative merge timestamp is preserved; a transcription
error in the event bullet was explicitly corrected.

#456 was claimed by its Opus updater at19:26:32Z. Its previously checked
worktree is clean at approved `e8a69238`; four full reviewed heads are retained.
After normal refresh/gates MAIN will test strict carry, or make a bounded
terminal disposition if the patch changes. No fifth full review is pre-queued.
Then #299 and #481 remain the next proof priorities. Other already-claimed
publication packets must preserve that merge order.

The cycle snapshot completed. The previous cycle is progress by admitting the
independent review; this cycle completes the fifth of the owner's six stale
approved candidates. Caps0/0/0, no lanes or open native threads, and only the
model-free daemon merges. No #168 post; the full formalization goal stays active.
